chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar asked his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man who cleans his teeth once with his hand when he rises for Salat al-Layl, while he is able to use the siwak. So he said:
"If he fears the coming of dawn, there is no harm in it."

key_terms.السِّوَاكِ: the tooth-stick used for cleaning the teeth
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to clean the teeth with the hand before Salat al-Layl if dawn is near?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning cleaning the teeth before Salat al-Layl when a siwak is available. Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that if one fears the onset of dawn, there is no harm in using the hand instead.
